results.summary_before: This project is a digital desk clock that displays hours, minutes, and seconds in 24-hour format on six 7-segment displays. Because of limited output pins, the time data is shifted out serially to external 74xx596 shift registers that drive the displays. The time can be set using buttons, with fast and slow increment modes, and pressing both set buttons clears the seconds. Silicon testing by the author using a logic analyzer confirmed correct operation of the serial output.
results.summary: This project is a digital desk clock that displays hours, minutes, and seconds in 24-hour format on six 7-segment displays. Because of limited output pins, the time data is shifted out serially to external 74xx596 shift registers that drive the displays. The time can be set using the hours_set and minutes_set inputs, with fast and slow increment modes, and pressing both set inputs clears the seconds. Silicon testing by the author using a logic analyzer confirmed correct operation of the serial output.
